CodeTerminal.use: A terminal window that types a short Python snippet character by character, then prints its real output line by line, and highlights one output line. Use when the script shows a concrete calculation or code example and its printed result (e.g. quantisation sizes, a loop printing numbers).

props.code: python source shown being typed, <= 12 lines, use \n for newlines
props.output: its REAL printed output, <= 10 lines, use \n for newlines; keep the lines short
props.title: window title, default python
props.highlight: index (0-based) of the output line to box in yellow at impact, -1 for none

CodeTerminal.beats: reveal: code finished, output starts printing; impact: yellow box pops around the highlighted output line

Equation.use: A big formula shown as stacked numbers: a fraction (total over per-unit gives a result) or a product (a times b equals a result). Use to explain a calculation that yields one headline number, e.g. bandwidth divided by model size gives tokens per second, or parameters times bytes gives memory.

props.mode: fraction (num over den = result) | product (a x b = result)
props.num: fraction only: numerator value with unit, e.g. 60 GB/s
props.den: fraction only: denominator value with unit, e.g. ~4 GB
props.result: the answer shown after = (both modes), with unit, e.g. 15 token/s; keep it short
props.b: product only: second factor, e.g. 2 Byte
props.note: optional small caption at top right, <= 16 characters

Equation.beats: reveal: '=' and the result pop in; impact: yellow underline sweeps under the result and the result punches

TokenStream.use: Shows how a language model produces output. decode: an output bar where tokens appear one by one, each fed by a green data packet that must arrive first; use for the token-by-token generation step. prefill: a whole prompt is read at once and every chip lights up together; use for the step that processes the input prompt in one pass.

props.mode: decode (tokens appear one by one, each fed by a data packet) | prefill (whole prompt processed at once)
props.tokens: decode only: list of output tokens (short strings, 1-2 characters for Chinese), default ["因","为","大","模","型"]
props.rate: decode only: tokens per second, default 1.5
props.label: optional short text: decode shows it bottom right in orange; prefill shows it as a pill above the chips (default PREFILL)
props.prompt: prefill only: input text, one chip per character, keep it under about 20 characters

TokenStream.beats: decode: none needed, tokens start 0.4 s after entrance; prefill reveal: all chips light up and the label pill appears
